name: Wounds Treatment Of
overview: Scripture reveals that physical wounds serve a purifying purpose, as Proverbs 20:30 explains that the bruising of a wound acts like a cleansing medicine against evil. Isaiah 1:6 highlights the seriousness of untreated wounds, describing a state of spiritual and physical brokenness when sores are left unbound and unhealed. Luke 10:34 exemplifies Christlike compassion in the practical treatment of wounds, showing the care of binding wounds and anointing them with oil and wine, symbolizing both physical healing and mercy.
